description: This source file defines an enum-based state system for representing icon states in a SwiftUI application, including various activity roles, tool kinds, and visual override options. It provides properties for determining badge symbols, prominences, and activity status, as well as converting override selections to icon states.

methods.name: badgeSymbolName
methods.description: Returns the symbol name associated with the current icon state for UI display.

methods.name: badgeProminence
methods.description: Determines the prominence level of the badge based on the icon state.

methods.name: isWorking
methods.description: Indicates whether the current icon state signifies ongoing activity.

methods.name: toIconState
methods.description: Converts an override selection to its corresponding icon state.
